DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-0.an: Oh? Another one come to rummage through my collection. You smell of... burnt pages.
DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-1.ch: That would be the forbidden books. I have burned a great many. And read a great many.
DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-2.an: Then you are exactly the right sort! People who burn books treasure them most. Take something. I forget what I have.
DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.1-0r.a: Back again? Your robes are even more threadbare than last time. Scholarship is hard on clothing.
DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-0.an:
I have a thing here that supposedly restores spells you have forgotten.
Though remembering is not always a kindness.
DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-1.ch:
[i][font_size=22]The Wizard is quiet for a moment, tapping his cuff three times.[/font_size][/i]
The ones I forgot, I burned with my own hands.
DARV.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-2.an: ...Ha. Then you understand collecting better than I do. Choose, then go. And do not burn anything here.
NEOW.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-0.ch: Did you drag me back to try again, or to watch how I die?
NEOW.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-1.ch: Give me a scroll fragment left behind by this tower. Just one page.
NEOW.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-2.an: [sine]...Take it... ..but all who read it... ..regret it.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0: I do not need to be beautiful. I need to be useful.
What a waste of a sentence! Should power not also be a pleasure to look at?
NONUPEIPE.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.1: Those robes... I cannot bear to look twice. Come here, let me add some colour.
NONUPEIPE.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2: A proposal: I gild your spells with light, and in exchange you must remember what you originally looked like.
I do not need to remember. I need it to work.
What a tedious man. Take it, and let me see your light - though it will never illuminate you.
You ask too many questions, and none of them connect. Rather like my notebooks.
NOTEBOOKS!! Excellent!! Would you like a lightning bolt instead!! Lightning is a kind of notebook!!
OROBAS.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.1-0r: You again!! Did the thing I gave you break yet!! If it broke, come get another!!
A question for you - if a spell is cast and nobody sees it, did it happen at all!?
It happened. It leaves marks on people. They simply refuse to admit it.
!! I like that answer!! Take two!! No - the rule is one!!
PAEL.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-0.ch: When you sleep, do you know nothing at all? I envy that.
PAEL.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-1.an: [thinky_dots]A quiet one... only those who know too much wish for quiet...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.1-0r.a: [thinky_dots]Your eyes are tired... they have read what should not be read...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-0.an: [thinky_dots]Take it... a little flesh that will never dream...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-1.ch: I do not fear dreaming. I fear waking up and still remembering.
PAEL.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-2.an: [thinky_dots]Then carry it... and go to sleep... though you never will...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-0.ch: I am not good at fighting. I am very good at making things cease to exist.
TANX.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-1.an: [b]Those are two different things!! Here, take this and make them one!![/b]
TANX.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.1-0r.a: [b]Your hands are steady but your shoulders shake!! That is not a contradiction, that is insufficient training!![/b]
TANX.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-0.an: [b]They say you burned your own books!! Then you should know - power only grows when you burn the old things!![/b]
TANX.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-1.ch: Every one I burned, I still remember its contents.
TANX.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-2.an: [b]Good!! Better to remember than to forget!! Take up arms and use them all!![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0: Fire. The first spell, and the most honest.
Honest? Darling, fire is never honest. It is merely [jitter][b]sincere[/b][/jitter].
TEZCATARA.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.1: Your hands are covered in old scars, and not one of them looks like a fight. You did that to yourself, did you not?
TEZCATARA.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2: Try this. I brewed it from [jitter][b]what was left after the burning[/b][/jitter]. You will recognise it.
...I do not recognise this taste. How many more secrets do you have?
Then you had better finish it. With strength, you will be able to see more of the secrets in this tower.
VAKUU.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-0.c: What do you want? I have little of value and a great deal of debt.
VAKUU.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.0-1.a: [sine]Debt[/sine]... I like that word. It is far more honest than gold.
I still have the last contract you signed. The ink is fading... you are forgetting what you agreed to.
VAKUU.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-0.a: A new contract. One clause only: you receive the knowledge you want, and in exchange you may never write it down.
VAKUU.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACTER.2-2.a: I know. That is why I put it on the first line. Sign.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.WIZARD-WIZARD_CHARACT: You have read a great many things you should not have. You believe you understand.
Perhaps I do not understand. But I have written down what I saw, down to the last detail.
Recitation is not comprehension. You treat the Spire as a book. It is a building.
You came back again. Each time you are weaker, and each time more certain. That interests me.
A price must be paid. I simply budget for it in advance.
Budgets are for the living. You have begun keeping accounts like a dead man.
Tell me. What exactly do you intend to take from this Spire?
The last page. The one with your name on it.
...Then you must first admit that every page you have read was only preparation for this one. Come.
